meta.what: acc(N, t): final-step argmax test accuracy of each family after t training updates (lr 1e-3, batch 8000, Adam) at hidden width N; judged joint extrapolation model per family

units.t: training updates at lr 1e-3 (np.inf = infinite training)

meta.evaluate: import extrap_final as X; X.predict(family, N, t, draw = None)  (module next to this file)
meta.grid_layout: predictions[family]['point'|'p2.5'|'p50'|'p97.5'|'envelope_lo'|'envelope_hi'][i_N][i_t] with i_N over N_grid, i_t over t_grid
meta.interval: 2.5 / 97.5 percentiles over the model's bootstrap draws (statistical only; see structural_alternatives and calibration for what they miss)
meta.t_conv: updates until acc(N, t) >= acc(N, inf) - 0.01; null = not reached by 1e30 updates
meta.envelope: limits.envelope_lo / envelope_hi: union of the 95% intervals of the chosen model and of the structural alternatives listed in limits.envelope_members (forms that fit the data comparably but extrapolate differently); use it for error bars wherever N or t lies beyond the data
meta.verification: every attempt's reported point backtests were reproduced by rerunning its own code on the judge's common splits (judge/score.py, bt_*.json); this module reproduces each attempt's own predictions to <= 1.4e-7

depth 1.description: kl-space attempt, accuracy-gap comparator ('int-sat' form fitted to 0.7663 - acc): acc = 0.7663 - (Z0 - E) [c(n) + (1 - c(n)) (1 + (t/1000) phi(n) / t0)^-beta] - E, Z0 = 0.6663, c(n) = 1 / (1 + (n/n1)^alpha), phi(n) = 1 / (n^-g + nc^-g), n = N/1000; point fit E = 0 (so acc(inf, inf) = 0.7663 by assumption), first fitted checkpoint 1k; draws = multiverse bootstrap (width curves resampled, first checkpoint 1k/2k/3k and E free/0 drawn at random). params p = [E, ln n1, alpha, (unused), beta, g, ln t0, log10 nc, (unused)]
depth 1.decision: kl-acc: best time extrapolation among forms that fit (B2 10.5, B5 13.6 vs smooth-max 16.4 / 46.6 and shape 11.4 / 27.9; per width at N >= 1000 the B5 error is -0.005..+0.015 vs -0.05..-0.07 for smooth-max); its limits barely move with the training window (acc(1e4, inf) .722/.740/.742/.744 for t <= 5/10/15/20k, smooth-max .505/.558/.620/.643); best calibrated (time PI coverage .82/.82, interval score .08-.11 vs smooth-max .41-1.43). Ties kl-space (KL space + h map) and is simpler. Weak spots: width extrapolation B1 -0.018 (wide nets beat the narrow-width trend) and capacity-limited small widths: their late gains are over-predicted (B2 +0.014..+0.030 at N = 10-50) and their limits sit 0.09-0.14 above the per-run pinned limits (N = 20: .317 vs .223).

Width stops buying speed above N ~ 30 (nc = 32), so the wide curves share one time course and differ only by capacity. Caveats: its time PI under-covers at large widths (B5 coverage .64; .40 at N >= 1000: too narrow and slightly low), small saturated widths are over-predicted (N = 200 limit .50 vs per-run pinned .34), and 196 of 200 draws have E < 0.01, so its zero-width interval at N >= 1e6 is an assumption (joint-Bayes cap) rather than a measurement: use the envelope.

smooth-max:primary:both.description: smooth-max attempt, primary: deficit D = ((A n^-alpha)^p + (B (t s(n) + t0)^-beta)^p)^(1/p), acc = 0.1 + (a - 0.1) exp(-D), s(n) = (n / (1 + n/nc))^g, n = N/1000, t in k-updates; A = e^lA, B = e^lB, t0 = e^lt0, p = e^lp, nc = e^lnc; draws = 'both' bootstrap (width curves + 4-checkpoint blocks)

kl-space:kl:kl_joint.description: kl-space attempt, accuracy-gap comparator ('int-sat' form fitted to 0.7663 - acc): acc = 0.7663 - (Z0 - E) [c(n) + (1 - c(n)) (1 + (t/1000) phi(n) / t0)^-beta] - E, Z0 = 0.6663, c(n) = 1 / (1 + (n/n1)^alpha), phi(n) = 1 / (n^-g + nc^-g), n = N/1000; point fit E = 0 (so acc(inf, inf) = 0.7663 by assumption), first fitted checkpoint 1k; draws = multiverse bootstrap (width curves resampled, first checkpoint 1k/2k/3k and E free/0 drawn at random). params p = [E, ln n1, alpha, (unused), beta, g, ln t0, log10 nc, (unused)]
